description.value: Jerusalem Shawarma is a Palestinian-rooted family business serving shawarma, donair, falafel, hummus, and kababs on busy Robson Street in downtown Vancouver. The restaurant offers dine-in seating indoors alongside takeout and online ordering for pickup. It is part of a multi-location chain with roots in its founder's grandfather's village restaurant in Palestine, emphasizing fresh Mediterranean cuisine.
